policy: Provisional EUR-based prices per licensed user per month: Single (1 app) €35; Mixed (2–5 apps) receives 20% off the combined single-app prices (€56, €84, €112, €140); Bundle (6 apps) receives 30% off (€147). Organisation discounts apply after bundle discounts: 1–4 users 0%, 5–19 users 10%, 20–49 users 20%, 50+ users custom quotation. Discounts and totals are calculated in EUR, then converted to DKK or USD at the published indicative reference exchange rates. VAT is excluded. The seven-day trial is planned, and billing and checkout are not yet live.

referenceConversion.note: EUR is the only base price and intended billing currency. DKK and USD values are display equivalents converted from EUR using these indicative reference rates and rounded to two decimals. All discounts and totals must be computed in EUR before converting once for display. Rates are fixed until the published reference is updated; no live-FX guarantee.

derivedDisplayCurrencyNote: Do not independently edit converted DKK or USD prices: derive all display amounts from the EUR reference pricing.
